questions.q1: You prefer to focus on the outer world of people and things rather than the inner world of ideas.
questions.q2: You feel energized by spending time with groups of people.
questions.q3: You tend to think out loud and process ideas by talking them through.
questions.q4: You prefer quiet reflection and thinking before speaking.
questions.q5: You feel drained after spending long periods in social situations.
questions.q6: You prefer to focus on concrete facts and details rather than possibilities.
questions.q7: You trust information that comes from direct experience and observation.
questions.q8: You prefer practical, realistic approaches to problems.
questions.q9: You enjoy exploring theoretical concepts and future possibilities.
questions.q10: You often see patterns and connections that others miss.
questions.q11: You make decisions based primarily on logic and objective analysis.
questions.q12: You believe being honest is more important than being tactful.
questions.q13: You prefer to remain emotionally detached when making important decisions.
questions.q14: You consider people's feelings and values when making decisions.
questions.q15: You believe maintaining harmony is often more important than being right.
questions.q16: You prefer to have things settled and decided rather than open-ended.
questions.q17: You like to plan ahead and stick to schedules.
questions.q18: You feel comfortable making decisions quickly.
questions.q19: You prefer to keep your options open and adapt as you go.
questions.q20: You work best under pressure and close to deadlines.
